plan:
Here's a detailed plan to expand the UI design dataset from 8 to 40+ high-quality designs:

1. Additional Source Platforms
- Dribbble.com (Primary) - High-quality UI/UX portfolio designs
- Behance.net - Detailed case studies and UI systems
- Pinterest.com - UI component collections and inspiration boards
- UI8.net - Premium UI kits and design systems
- awwwards.com - Award-winning website designs

2. Platform-Specific Scraping Strategies

Dribbble:
- Target "Popular" and "UI Design" categories
- Filter for posts with 1000+ likes
- Focus on shots tagged with "UI", "Dashboard", "Mobile App"
- Extract: Image, color palette, tags, engagement metrics
- Aim: 15-20 designs

Behance:
- Focus on UI/UX project case studies
- Filter for featured projects
- Target projects with complete design systems
- Extract: Full-resolution images, project descriptions, tools used
- Aim: 10-12 designs

Pinterest:
- Search for "UI design system", "Mobile UI patterns"
- Target boards from established designers/companies
- Extract: High-res images, linked source content
- Aim: 8-10 designs

UI8 & Awwwards:
- Focus on free resources and previews
- Extract design system components
- Capture responsive layouts
- Aim: 5-8 designs each

3. Data Quality Filters
- Minimum resolution: 1440x900px
- Format requirements: PNG/JPG with transparency
- Metadata completeness check
- Design system component coverage >80%
- Remove duplicate/similar designs
- Verify attribution/licensing

4. Storage Optimization
- Implement WebP conversion for web delivery
- Store original files in cloud storage (S3/GCS)
- Maintain separate high/low-res versions
- Implement CDN for delivery
- Database structure:
```
{
  id: string,
  source: string,
  title: string,
  designer: string,
  images: {
    original: string,
    webp: string,
    thumbnail: string
  },
  metadata: {
    resolution: [width, height],
    colors: string[],
    tags: string[],
    components: string[]
  },
  metrics: {
    likes: number,
    views: number
  },
  license: string
}
```

5. Rate Limiting Considerations
- Implement exponential backoff
- Respect robots.txt
- Platform-specific limits:
  - Dribbble: 60 requests/hour
  - Behance: 150 requests/hour
  - Pinterest: 1000 requests/day
- Use request queuing
- Implement proxy rotation
- Cache responses
- Add random delays between requests (2-5s)

Implementation Timeline:
Week 1: Set up scrapers and storage
Week 2: Initial data collection and filtering
Week 3: Quality review and metadata enrichment
Week 4: Final processing and optimization

Success Metrics:
- Reach 40+ unique designs
- 95%+ metadata completeness
- <1% duplicate content
- 100% proper attribution
- Average quality score >8/10

Let me know if you need any clarification on specific aspects of the plan.
